visual_review.inspection_method: Every complete screenshot inspected with view_image at original sheet detail; whole images resized without cropping.
visual_review.observation: At 1.5 seconds, two complete upright gray rack spines are visible. The shorter left rack has three cyan arms, with its middle arm angled upward; the taller right rack has five distinct horizontal cyan arms. Joint markers and thin paths remain visible without obscuring the geometry. Playback controls and inspection panels fit the page. The imported GLB is explicitly labeled as having unknown numerical comparison status.
visual_review.scope: Actual static image observation; numerical conformance, continuous motion and final release acceptance are separate.
